research_question: What text, iconography and object identity belonged to each physical layer of the 1902 Mendes burial, and does any object-specific evidence distinguish CG 53469 from the generic funerary program?

primary_excavation.title: Note on a Tomb Found at Tell er Roba
primary_excavation.journal: Annales du Service des Antiquites de l'Egypte 3

stone_and_faience_amulets.interpretive_ceiling: Protective/restorative funerary functions are plausible for many categories, but object-by-object spell/function assignment requires iconographic/textual concordance and must not be inferred solely from shape.

quibell_front_body_sheet_concordance.importance: If locked from Vernier prose/image, the two-line lower-layer inscription belongs to CG 53466, not CG 53469.

forward_pass.operator: TOMB_OPENING -> TWO_BURIALS -> PROTECTED_DEPOSIT -> SHABTI_OWNER_IDENTITY -> BODY_GOLD_PROGRAM -> CG_MAPPING -> OBJECT_SPECIFIC_TEXT
forward_pass.result: The protected burial contains a coherent funerary program around Nesbanebdjed(et), but the lower layer also contains a previously underweighted two-line inscription that has not yet been read.

janus_reverse_pass.operator: CG53469_HYPOTHESIS -> REMOVE_LABEL_SEMANTICS -> LOCK_PHYSICAL_LAYER -> LOCK_OBJECT_NUMBER -> TRACE_NEIGHBOUR_TEXT -> TRACE_OWNER_TEXT -> REQUIRE_OBJECT_SPECIFIC_MARK -> TEST_GENERIC_VS_UNIQUE
steps: Start from CG 53469 without assuming Osiris identity.
Lock CG 53469 to the body-gold layer below the secondary slab.
Separate the phallus sheath from CG 53466 and all upper shabti/amulet material.
Use shabti inscriptions only to establish owner identity/titles, not object identity.
Recover the two-line inscription on the lower body ornament and bind it to its exact CG number.
Recover high-resolution surface records of CG 53465-53469 and inventory each mark.
Classify each divine/funerary motif as generic-to-assemblage or unique-to-CG53469.
Only promote an anomaly if CG53469 itself carries a distinctive reading not explained by the owner's ordinary funerary program.
If exterior text/iconography is generic or absent, demote the surface hypothesis and proceed to non-destructive internal imaging.

falsification_gates.surface_specialness_falsified_if: High-resolution and catalogue records show CG 53469 has no object-specific inscription/iconography and its morphology is ordinary within the gold body-trapping class.
falsification_gates.hidden_identity_hypothesis_falsified_if: The lower two-line inscription names Nesbanebdjed(et) and/or contains ordinary funerary formulae consistent with the upper shabti identity and neighbouring gold program.
falsification_gates.identity_anomaly_promoted_only_if: A securely read lower-layer text or CG53469-specific mark identifies a different person/entity or an anomalous formula and survives independent epigraphic review.

priority_order: recover a legible scan/photograph or ALTO image of the two-line inscription on the front-body gold sheet and lock its CG number
obtain full Vernier descriptive entries for CG 53465-53469 including any printed hieroglyphs
obtain high-resolution front/back/side imagery of CG 53469 and neighbouring gold objects
epigraphically transcribe and translate only legible signs
only if unresolved, proceed to CT/X-ray/conservation imaging
